📦 **Blockside `78a238d`** — feat(town): render shared orchard trees in cultivated plots

Append an orchard tree with field placement, reusing the broadleaf branch and leaf generators. Keep existing species order, seeds and meshes unchanged. Blocksail uses this shared tree for olive, citrus and mulberry plots.

Validated 132 existing meshes across two seeds and two LODs byte-for-byte; orchard geometry is finite and nonempty. Code-only build and source/output checks pass, with all 44 ship files unchanged.

Refs TASK-1214

👥 參與者：@meadow
